mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_idx, u.user_id, u.user_email, u.password_enabled, u.email_verified, u.email_login_enabled, u.account_status, u.user_role, u.member_grade, u.is_verified_member, u.cash_balance, u.mileage_balance, u.point_balance, u.level_no, u.exp_points, u.total_post_count, u.total_comment_count, u.dormant_at, u.dormant_release_required, u.blocked_until, u.blocked_reason, u.admin_position_code, u.admin_permission_code, u.nickname, u.nationality, u.preferred_lang, u.created_at, u.status_changed_at, IFNULL(s.social_count, 0) AS social_count, s.linked_providers, COALESCE(u.last_login_at, h.last_login_at) AS last_login_at, h.last_login_method, IFNULL(h.login_success_count, 0) AS login_success_count, IFNULL(h.login_fail_count, 0) AS login_fail_count
ORDER BY
h.last_login_at u.nickname u.created_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT u.*, IFNULL(s.social_count, 0) AS social_count, s.linked_providers, COALESCE(u.last_login_at, h.last_login_at) AS last_login_at, h.last_login_method, IFNULL(h.login_success_count, 0) AS login_success_count, IFNULL(h.login_fail_count, 0) AS login_fail_count FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, COUNT(*) AS social_count, GROUP_CONCAT(provider ORDER BY provider) AS linked_providers FROM USER_SOCIAL GROUP BY user_idx ) s ON u.user_idx = s.user_idx LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_idx, MAX(login_at) AS last_login_at, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(login_method ORDER BY login_at DESC), ',', 1) AS last_login_method, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS login_fail_count FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE auth_type IN ('PASSWORD', 'SOCIAL') GROUP BY user_idx ) h ON u.user_idx = h.user_idx WHERE u.user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET account_status = #{status}, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND user_role <> 'SYSTEM'
UPDATE USERS SET account_status = 'DORMANT', dormant_at = NOW(), dormant_release_required = TRUE, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND user_role <> 'SYSTEM'
UPDATE USERS SET dormant_at = NULL, dormant_release_required = FALSE, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
UPDATE USERS SET account_status = 'BLOCKED', blocked_until = #{blockedUntil}, blocked_reason = #{blockedReason}, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND user_role <> 'SYSTEM'
UPDATE USERS SET blocked_until = NULL, blocked_reason = NULL, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}

UPDATE USERS SET member_grade = #{memberGrade}, is_verified_member = #{verifiedMember}, cash_balance = #{cashBalance}, mileage_balance = #{mileageBalance}, point_balance = #{pointBalance}, level_no = #{levelNo}, exp_points = #{expPoints}, admin_position_code = #{adminPositionCode}, admin_permission_code = #{adminPermissionCode} WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_BLOCK_HISTORY ( block_request_id, block_target_key, user_idx, block_type, blocked_ip, is_active, reason, blocked_by_user_idx, blocked_at, expires_at, ip_match_type, ip_block_registered_at, created_by_user_idx, created_at, updated_by_user_idx, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{blockRequestId}, #{blockTargetKey}, #{userIdx}, #{blockType}, #{blockedIp}, TRUE, #{reason}, #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW(), #{expiresAt}, #{ipMatchType}, CASE WHEN #{blockedIp} IS NOT NULL AND #{blockedIp} != '' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW(), #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT block_idx FROM USER_BLOCK_HISTORY WHERE block_request_id = #{blockRequestId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_BLOCKLIST ( source_history_block_idx, block_request_id, block_target_key, user_idx, block_type, blocked_ip, is_active, snapshot_status, reason, blocked_by_user_idx, blocked_at, expires_at, last_history_at, synced_at, created_by_user_idx, created_at, updated_by_user_idx, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceHistoryBlockIdx}, #{blockRequestId}, #{blockTargetKey}, #{userIdx}, #{blockType}, #{blockedIp}, TRUE, 'ACTIVE', #{reason}, #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW(), #{expiresAt}, NOW(), NOW(), #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW(), #{blockedByUserIdx}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_history_block_idx = VALUES(source_history_block_idx), block_request_id = VALUES(block_request_id), user_idx = VALUES(user_idx), block_type = VALUES(block_type), blocked_ip = VALUES(blocked_ip), is_active = TRUE, snapshot_status = 'ACTIVE', reason = VALUES(reason), blocked_by_user_idx = VALUES(blocked_by_user_idx), blocked_at = NOW(), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), released_by_user_idx = NULL, released_at = NULL, last_history_at = NOW(), synced_at = NOW(), updated_by_user_idx = VALUES(blocked_by_user_idx), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT block_idx FROM USER_BLOCKLIST WHERE block_target_key = #{blockTargetKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT blocked_ip FROM USER_BLOCK_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND is_active = TRUE AND block_type IN ('IP_ONLY', 'USER_IP') AND blocked_ip IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = FALSE, snapshot_status = CASE WHEN expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'RELEASED' END, released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, released_at = NOW(), synced_at = NOW(), updated_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND is_active = TRUE

UPDATE USER_BLOCK_HISTORY SET is_active = FALSE, released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, released_at = NOW(), ip_block_released_at = CASE WHEN blocked_ip IS NOT NULL THEN NOW() ELSE ip_block_released_at END, list_synced_at = NOW(), updated_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND is_active = TRUE

UPDATE USERS SET user_role = #{role}, admin_position_code = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'USER' THEN NULL ELSE admin_position_code END, admin_permission_code = CASE WHEN #{role} = 'USER' THEN NULL ELSE admin_permission_code END WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'DORMANT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dormantMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'DELETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deletedMembers, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayNewMembers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE auth_type IN ('PASSWORD', 'SOCIAL') AND is_success = TRUE AND DATE(login_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayLogins, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_LOGIN_HISTORY WHERE auth_type IN ('PASSWORD', 'SOCIAL') AND is_success = FALSE AND DATE(login_at) = CURDATE()) AS todayFailedLogins, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_idx) FROM USER_SOCIAL WHERE provider = 'KAKAO') AS kakaoLinked, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_idx) FROM USER_SOCIAL WHERE provider = 'NAVER') AS naverLinked, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_idx) FROM USER_SOCIAL WHERE provider = 'GOOGLE') AS googleLinked, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST) AS totalCommunityPosts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMUNITY_POST WHERE post_status = 'ACTIVE') AS activeCommunityPosts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS activeReports, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY_POST) AS totalInquiries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY_POST WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingInquiries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INQUIRY_POST WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') AS completedInquiries FROM USERS
mapper.sql:
FROM INQUIRY_POST ip INNER JOIN USERS u ON ip.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN INQUIRY_ANSWER ia ON ip.inquiry_id = ia.inquiry_id LEFT JOIN USERS au ON ia.admin_user_idx = au.user_idx
AND ip.status = #{status}
AND ip.category = #{category}
AND ia.answer_id IS NOT NULL
AND ia.answer_id IS NULL
AND ip.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ip.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ( ip.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ip.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT ip.inquiry_id, ip.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.account_status, ip.title, ip.content, ip.category, ip.is_private, ip.status, ip.view_count, ip.created_at, ip.updated_at, ia.answer_id, ia.content AS answer_content, au.nickname AS answer_admin_nickname, ia.created_at AS answered_at
ORDER BY ip.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT ip.inquiry_id, ip.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.account_status, ip.title, ip.content, ip.category, ip.is_private, ip.status, ip.view_count, ip.created_at, ip.updated_at, ia.answer_id, ia.content AS answer_content, au.nickname AS answer_admin_nickname, ia.created_at AS answered_at FROM INQUIRY_POST ip INNER JOIN USERS u ON ip.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN INQUIRY_ANSWER ia ON ip.inquiry_id = ia.inquiry_id LEFT JOIN USERS au ON ia.admin_user_idx = au.user_idx WHERE ip.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalInquiries, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingInquiries, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgressInquiries, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED','USER_COMPLETED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedInquiries FROM INQUIRY_POST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INQUIRY_ANSWER (inquiry_id, admin_user_idx, content) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{adminUserIdx}, #{content})

SELECT h.login_idx, h.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, h.auth_type, h.login_method, h.login_identifier, h.is_success, h.fail_reason, h.ip_address, h.user_agent, h.login_at
ORDER BY h.login_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT s.security_idx, s.user_idx, s.actor_user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, au.user_id AS actor_user_id, au.nickname AS actor_nickname, s.event_type, s.event_stage, s.input_identifier, s.target_email, s.is_success, s.fail_reason, s.detail_message, s.ip_address, s.user_agent, s.occurred_at
ORDER BY s.occurred_at DESC, s.security_idx DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.email_verification_request_idx, r.request_id, r.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, r.purpose, r.pending_email, r.status, r.requested_at, r.verified_at, r.applied_at, r.expired_at, r.cancelled_at, r.ip_address, r.user_agent, r.updated_at, r.created_at
ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC, r.email_verification_request_idx DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

FROM EMAIL_VERIFICATION v LEFT JOIN USERS u ON v.user_idx = u.user_idx
AND v.used = TRUE

AND v.purpose = #{purpose}
AND ( IFNULL(u.user_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(u.nickname, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(v.email, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(v.request_id, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(v.ip_address, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT v.verify_idx, v.email_verification_request_idx, v.request_id, v.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, v.email, v.token, v.purpose, v.used, v.used_at, v.expired_at, v.cancelled_at, v.updated_at, v.created_at
ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.verify_idx DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT a.activity_idx, a.request_id, a.user_idx, u.user_id, u.nickname, a.session_id, a.request_uri, a.http_method, a.activity_type, a.activity_code, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.handler_name, a.query_string, a.referer, a.ip_address, a.user_agent, a.response_status, a.response_time_ms, a.is_success, a.detail_summary, a.created_at
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.activity_idx DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT r.report_id, r.user_idx, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.description, r.status, r.created_at, r.resolved_at, r.resolve_action, r.source_type, r.source_id, u.nickname, u.user_id, u.account_status, u.user_role, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT r2 WHERE r2.target_type = r.target_type AND r2.target_id = r.target_id ) AS target_report_count, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'post' THEN (SELECT post_status FROM COMMUNITY_POST WHERE post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'comment' THEN (SELECT comment_status FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'user' THEN (SELECT account_status FROM USERS WHERE user_idx = r.target_id) END AS target_status
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT r.report_id, r.user_idx, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reason, r.description, r.status, r.created_at, r.resolved_at, r.resolve_action, r.source_type, r.source_id, u.nickname, u.user_id, u.account_status, u.user_role, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT r2 WHERE r2.target_type = r.target_type AND r2.target_id = r.target_id ) AS target_report_count, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'user' THEN (SELECT tu.user_role FROM USERS tu WHERE tu.user_idx = r.target_id) WHEN 'post' THEN (SELECT tu.user_role FROM COMMUNITY_POST p JOIN USERS tu ON p.user_idx = tu.user_idx WHERE p.post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'comment' THEN (SELECT tu.user_role FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT c JOIN USERS tu ON c.user_idx = tu.user_idx WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id) END AS target_user_role, CASE r.target_type WHEN 'post' THEN (SELECT post_status FROM COMMUNITY_POST WHERE post_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'comment' THEN (SELECT comment_status FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE comment_id = r.target_id) WHEN 'user' THEN (SELECT account_status FROM USERS WHERE user_idx = r.target_id) END AS target_status FROM REPORT r LEFT JOIN USERS u ON r.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}
